summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure) regarding a regular cash distribution of $0.1840 per share declared on April 30, 2026, payable on May 29, 2026, and Item 8.01 (Other Events) updating its ongoing private placement of common shares, noting receipt of ~$8.7 million in subscriptions in April 2026. The filing also provides a routine monthly NAV update ($24.88 per share as of March 31, 2026) and leverage metrics. This is a standard periodic report with no special-situation elements such as M&A, tender, restructuring, or activism.
